changes.name: roll
changes.impact: There is no way back once the new control plane machine has joined the platform cluster: the run restores nothing and has no rollback, and neither Cancel nor Remove brings the old machines or the old Kubernetes version back. A step that fails leaves the machines that still run serving, and Retry goes on at that step. Tenant backups are the only net for a database whose volume does not follow it to the new machine.

changes.name: release
changes.impact: Nothing is synced for it: the platform's record and the labels of its objects name the new release.

changes.name: kubernetes.version
changes.impact: Every machine of the platform cluster is replaced by Cluster API, the control plane first, then one node group and node at a time. The rows roll/… say per unit what stops serving meanwhile.

changes.name: kubernetes.nodeImage
changes.impact: Every machine of the platform cluster is replaced by Cluster API, the control plane first, then one node group and node at a time. The rows roll/… say per unit what stops serving meanwhile.

changes.name: pc-platform
changes.impact: The Application moves to the new chart version with the first step of the roll (rows roll/…).

changes.name: roll/controlPlane
changes.impact: The 3 control plane machines are replaced one at a time, one more machine first. No gap of the platform cluster's API is expected: the other machines keep etcd and the API address. Not measured on a lab yet.

changes.name: roll/system@pve1
changes.impact: The platform's operators (ArgoCD, Cluster API for tenants, CloudNativePG, MetalLB, cert-manager) restart on the new machine. A MetalLB address may move to another node (seconds). Tenant API servers, tenant workloads and databases keep running. Not measured on a lab yet.

changes.name: roll/kamaji@pve2
changes.impact: The one kamaji machine is replaced: ALL tenant API servers are away while their pods restart on the new machine, and kamaji-etcd moves with its disk. Tenant workloads keep running; nothing in a tenant cluster can be created or changed meanwhile. Not measured on a lab yet.

changes.name: roll/dbaas@pve3
changes.impact: Every database with one instance on this machine is down while its pod moves to the new machine and its disk is attached there. A database with three instances fails over. The platform cluster holds 0 databases with one instance. Node pve3 has no room for one more machine of this group, so the old machine is deleted BEFORE the new one exists: everything on it is away for the whole clone and join, and stays away if the new machine fails to join, until a Retry succeeds. Not measured on a lab yet.

changes.name: roll-vm/controlPlane
changes.to: 3 new VM on pve1 cloned from template 9201, 3 old VM deleted with its boot disk (one more VM than today exists on the node while a machine is replaced)
changes.impact: Cluster API clones the new VM and deletes the old one with its boot disk. Volumes of proxmox-csi are separate disks and are kept. Only VMs that carry this installation's tag (pc-platform-pi-0a1b2c3d) are deleted: no other VM on the node is touched.
